name: actor
doc: Things that exist in time and space and act there: a computer, a natural process, or an AI.

types.name: ActorKind
types.doc: What kind of actor it is.

variants.name: natural_process
variants.doc: Something that happens in nature without anyone running it, such as weather or erosion.

variants.name: ai
variants.doc: A model or system that produces output from input.

types.name: Actor
types.doc: A thing that acts in time and space. Its existence in time is a time::Existence, and its size in two or three dimensions is a space::Dimensions.
